calibration.role: Fit physical-front-end coefficients using A/C only.

validation.role: IDs 1..8000: model selection; 8001..10000: global alpha fitting. A/C only.

scheduling: Each consecutive block of 1440 channels is a fresh permutation of all condition triples; incomplete block is a prefix. Nested prefixes are balanced to within one channel per condition.
waveform: One common full-load QPSK waveform per independent channel, with the union of A/B/C/D reference symbols inserted. Only A/C observation masks are exposed. B/D are geometry metadata, not source observations.

ber.data_mask: Complement of union of A/B/C/D potential pilot REs (200 RE); identical for every layout.
ber.receiver: Perfect timing; fixed single-tap ZF or MMSE equalizer must be frozen before final evaluation.
ber.scope: Uncoded BER. No transport-block coding/decoding or BLER. Common-waveform pilot-estimation benchmark, not separate standard-compliant PDSCH codeword generation per layout.

noise.placement: Independent complex AWGN added on the demodulated 120x14 grid.
noise.variance: E|W|^2 = 10^(-snr_db/10) relative to nominal unit symbol/channel energy.
noise.convention: Es/N0-like nominal SNR, not measured receive SNR and not Eb/N0.

metrics.mse: mean_RE(abs(H_hat-H_true)**2), complex MSE, 1680 RE, float64 accumulation, no factor 1/2
metrics.aggregation: Average per-observation linear metrics before 10*log10; preserve per-layout/per-condition/per-training-seed results. Paired channel-cluster uncertainty because A/C share H, X, Y and W.
metrics.saved_truth: H_true complex64 and target_energy float64 = mean_RE(abs(H_true)**2) of the stored truth; save each fitted model prediction separately at evaluation.

limitations: Fixed 120x14 grid, TDL-A, ideal timing, exact nominal side information.
High Doppler waveform includes ICI: Y_noiseless need not equal H_true*X.
Calibration/validation are development data, not independent final tests.
Real and imaginary components and paired A/C views are not additional independent channels.

future_test.rule: Create a separately hashed protocol with disjoint seeds after all models, calibration, alpha, receiver and metrics are frozen. Never use final B/D labels to tune.

storage: MAT v6 uncompressed, 500 independent channels/shard; shared H/X/Y stored once per channel, lazy A/C views via dataset_loader.py; atomic shard then SHA256 completion marker.
